controls.courtBasis: Original provisional section: courtyard 6m above the exterior foundation datum. With mapped tower 32m and an estimated 1m parapet, the 25m rise from court to platform is consistent with official platform 400m and the broad OSM castle ele375. This is an inference, not a surveyed courtyard altitude or verified common datum.

entrance.basis: Mapped building-passage endpoints retained; arch width and section original estimates

roofPole.basis: Mapped roof flagpole height12 interpreted as pole length above the viewing platform; shared tower/terrain datum remains provisional

nationalPole.basis: Original estimate of the second roof pole seen in the operator exterior photo

published.precision: Operator-published altitude and change, not a relative tower height or ground survey

controls.basis: Complete current castle footprint and its explicit courtyard hole, fifteen separately mapped building parts, eastern mapped passage/bridge, upper funicular-station shell and ticket office. Component heights are mapper tags. The 6m courtyard offset, ridge sections, facade openings and modern gallery details are original photographic estimates awaiting actual-site section review.

nativeAxes.longitudinal: Native+X east,+Z south; mapped components and passage, heading0.
nativeAxes.origin: Mapped castle horizontal anchor; exterior foundationY0 and provisional inner courtY6. Intended terrain attachment samples the inner court plane, not the tower roof.

reconstruction.scope: Complete current castle exterior complex, open irregular court, all fifteen mapped building parts, roofed wings/towers, chapel, projecting bays, glazed halls, east gateway/bridge, upper station shell and ticket office
reconstruction.basis: Original deterministic model from attributed OSM controls and castle-operator photos; no copied mesh, plan or photograph redistributed
reconstruction.referenceState: Current castle exterior; terrain grading, interior exhibits and surrounding city excluded; geographic heights remain provisional
